thread:
elaine: Quick sync — kickoff for API surface negotiation for sprint. Need final scope for chat/completions, function-calling, embeddings, rerank, structured output. Main asks: launch gating, types+examples for Py/TS, and changelog policy. Who owns gating criteria?
kevin: I can take gating. Proposal: must have API contract tests + 2 typesafe client examples (py/ts) + perf markers for latency < target on hosted and dedicated. Thoughts?
anya: agree on tests/examples. For types we need: typed responses for structured output, function calling signatures, and embeddings shape. I'll draft TS types.
sam: Eng: perf markers ok but we need clear seq-length and batch profiles. Also flag any model-variant fallbacks.
elaine: Customer asks: enterprise wants deterministic structured outputs and stable function-calling signatures. Add 'no-breaking change without major' to gating?
kevin: Yup. Changelog format: semantic headings: BREAKING / NEW / FIX / NOTES. Every breaking change needs migration guide and min 2 integration tests failing->fixed.
anya: For SDKs — scope: expose unified Chat + Completions surface, plus function-calls helper util, embeddings with vector typing. Examples: quickstart, structured-output-guides, rerank example.
docs-bot: reminder: docs deploy window Thurs 10:00 PT. Anything merged after Wed 17:00 will miss launch.
sam: cross-checking: does rerank require new server side endpoint or can we map to embeddings+scoring? That affects API surface.
elaine: Product: prefer endpoint 'rerank' for first pass (easier for customers). Eng to estimate effort by EOD.
kevin: I'll own the docs checklist and changelog. anya owns types + examples. sam do eng integration tests/perf. Elaine will own launch decision.
anya: PR for TS types coming in today. Will include sample code for function-calling typed signatures.
sam: I'll add perf benchmarks to the test harness and run on staging. ETA Wed morning.
elaine: Great. Action items: kevin doc checklist, anya types+examples, sam perf + tests. Sync live Thurs 11:00 PT to sign off. :thumbsup:
kevin: noted. tagging @anya @sam for visibility. Thanks!
